summary: TWO BEDROOMED TERRACED HOME My Property Box are delighted to offer this fabulous two bedroomed terraced property situated in a convenient location close to the local amenities and within easy walking distance to Darlington train station. The accommodation comprises of Lounge, Dining Room, Kitchen, Two Double Bedrooms, Bathroom with shower, Double Glazed, Gas Central Heating, Yard to the rear. Property Excludes all Utilities and also Council Tax.
